verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests auditability. Transactions are recorded from a prior calculation, products are categorized for tax purposes, and transactions can be read back through the MCP server. Nothing shows that the rate, rules, resolved address or jurisdiction, and category behind each transaction's tax are retained as a reconstructable record or can be exported for an audit. Missing for 10: a documented per-transaction breakdown of rate, jurisdiction and rule, a record of how the address or IP was resolved, the product category stored on each transaction, audit export or reporting functionality, and any independent corroboration.
